faq.q: What are Amazon's main image requirements?
faq.a: Start with a pure white backdrop and a product that fills about 85% of the square, with no text, badges or props. Check Seller Central for the current rule before you publish.

faq.q: What happens if an image does not meet the rules?
faq.a: Keep the main image plain, and put callouts only on later gallery images. Amazon can suppress a non-compliant image, and that can keep the listing out of search.

faq.q: Can I make a white main from a regular photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo and choose the plain main. The item is placed on an empty backdrop. You do not book a studio for that frame.

faq.q: Can I process a whole catalog in one job?
faq.a: No. Each file is its own job from one upload, and the credit cost shows before that job.

faq.q: Which images should follow the main image?
faq.a: A tight detail, a size cue, and an in-use view. Each one should answer the shopper's next question.
Add them yourself after download, and only on images after the main. The main image stays free of badges and slogans.

faq.q: Can I make a video for the listing?
faq.a: Yes, as a separate job of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Check the current Sponsored Brands and product-video rules before you use it. A still is 24 credits.

faq.q: How do I make the white main image?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo and choose the plain white main. Follow [Amazon white background photo](/guides/white-background-amazon), then confirm the live rule in Seller Central.
